_doc: X-6 forbidden-identifier manifest (CRM EXPORT SPEC §10.2 FORBIDDEN_IDENTIFIERS, widened to §2.3's never-exported list per _governance/X6_POSTGRES_OWNED_ASSURANCE_PLAN.md R1). Read by scripts/ci/x6_gate.sh (T-CI-X6-01/03) and supabase/tests/152_crm_export_x6.sql (T-RPC-CRM-14). No check may carry its own copy of this list.
_omitted_on_purpose: identity_id, ticket_atom_id, credential_version and serial_no are §2.3 never-EXPORTED columns but are the join keys the export SQL must legitimately name (the HMAC input, the consent join, the scan join); their non-export is asserted by the closed column manifest (crm_export_columns.json, T-CI-X6-02 / T-RPC-CRM-16), not by a source scan. card_last4 is omitted because no such identifier exists anywhere in the repository (rule 3 rename-tripwire would fail vacuously).
